audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart was internally incoherent: Levels 4-5 and First item were 'Skill' while their why-text argued opposite things, Level 6 was Lillia but its why said the lane flips to Mundo, and 2+ items was Lillia while its why called Mundo a raid boss.
audit.why: The packet chart is Lillia through First item, Dr. Mundo at 2+ items, and every whys[] entry agrees — whys[6] is explicit that 2+ items is where Mundo takes over.
audit.corrected: Lillia, Lillia, Lillia, Lillia, Lillia, Lillia, Dr. Mundo — ratings 2/2/2/3/2/4/7, with why-text rewritten so no stage argues against its own side.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on any of Lillia's spikes, and Level 6 was written as Mundo's flip point when it is her dive spike.
audit.why: Lilting Lullaby is 150/130/110s and Blooming Blows drops to 4s at rank 5. Mundo's real flip is 2+ items, not 6.
audit.corrected: Level 6 belongs to Lillia's Lullaby dive on a 150s rank-1 cooldown; Mundo's spike is two HP items plus MR.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two fields call Mundo's E a dash ('save your E Blunt Force Trauma dash-charge', 'save E Blunt Force Trauma to reposition'). Blooming Blows' true damage was never mentioned. 'Spirit Visor' is not an item.
audit.why: Blunt Force Trauma is a targeted slam with an auto-attack reset and zero mobility — Mundo has no dash at all, which is exactly why Swirlseed cutting his retreat matters. Blooming Blows deals extra TRUE damage on its outer edge, so armour and MR do not reduce it. The item is Spirit Visage.
audit.corrected: Remove the dash claims, state that Mundo has no dash so Flash is reserved for the disengage, name the true-damage edge, and fix Spirit Visage.

audit.whatIsWrong: suspectNames flagged "Maximum Dosage's" in spikes[3].text as a probable wrong name.
audit.why: Maximum Dosage is Dr. Mundo's real R name; the flag is the possessive apostrophe, a false positive.

edits.before: Your sustain starts beating his chip. Track Blooming Blows and take the trades it can't answer; you regen, he doesn't.
edits.after: Dream Dust burns percent max HP, so a deep bar doesn't help yet. Blooming Blows is 4.5s at rank 4 — farm, don't trade.

edits.before: Maximum Dosage makes you nearly unkillable in long fights. The lane flips from 'survive' to 'walk at him' the moment you hit 6.
edits.after: Lilting Lullaby (150s at rank 1) drowses then sleeps you — that is a dive, not a duel. Maximum Dosage can't out-heal a jungler.

edits.before: Heartsteel/Warmog's online — you out-HP every trade. Run Lillia down with E + R; only Grievous Wounds slows you now.
edits.after: Heartsteel online, but one item isn't enough — her burn still out-trades partial tank stats. Buy MR before you walk at her.

edits.before: Lillia's Blooming Blows (Q) stack burn and her passive Dream Dust chunks big HP bars, so your green health bar bleeds fast every time she kites and re-engages. Her Q gives movement speed on hit, meaning you can't reliably close the gap to land Q Infected Bonesaw at range for the slow. Hug minions so she can't free-poke, and only throw Q when she commits.
edits.after: Lillia's Blooming Blows (Q) burn and her passive Dream Dust chunk big HP bars, so your green bar bleeds every time she kites back in. The outer edge of that Q deals TRUE damage — armour and MR do nothing against it — and every hit stacks move speed, so you cannot close. Hug minions to deny the angle and throw Q only when she commits.

edits.before: Her R Lilting Lullaby is a drowsy that ramps to a full sleep, and it lines up with a jungler dive. Your R Maximum Dosage heals a percent-max chunk, but if she times Lullaby to interrupt your all-in you eat a burst combo asleep. Save your E Blunt Force Trauma dash-charge and back off the wave if her jungle is unknown.
edits.after: Her R Lilting Lullaby (150s at rank 1) is a drowsy that ramps to a full sleep, and it lines up with a jungler dive. Maximum Dosage heals a percent-max chunk, but if she times Lullaby into your all-in you eat the burst asleep. You have no dash — hold Flash for the exit and back off if her jungle is unknown.

edits.before: Full tank Mundo laughs at magic DoT. She can't burst you through R Maximum Dosage's healing, and you're an unkillable frontline that walks her down in teamfights. Build MR early (Spirit Visor line) and you become her worst matchup on the map.
edits.after: Full tank Mundo laughs at magic DoT. She can't burst you through R Maximum Dosage's healing, and you're an unkillable frontline that walks her down in teamfights. Build MR early (Spirit Visage) and you become her worst matchup on the map.

edits.before: Levels 3 through 6 stay hers because her Dream Dust passive shreds a percent of your max health and her kite is unanswerable until you have items. Her R Lilting Lullaby at 6 is a real dive threat — save E Blunt Force Trauma to reposition and back off if her jungler could be near. Weather it; your spike is coming.
edits.after: Levels 3 through 6 stay hers because her Dream Dust passive shreds a percent of your max health and her kite is unanswerable until you have items. Lilting Lullaby at 6 is a real dive threat, and Blunt Force Trauma is a slam, not a dash — Mundo has no mobility, so Flash is the exit. Weather it; your spike is coming.

edits.before: Land Q Infected Bonesaw slows when she dashes in to chase
edits.after: Land Q Infected Bonesaw slows when she steps in to Q you

edits.before: Cleaver-slow him when Blooming Blows is down
edits.after: Cleaver-slow her when Blooming Blows is down

edits.before: - Lillia Blooming Blows: matchup-defining — Her kite + move speed stacks. Track it before every engage. - Your engage/committal tool: never waste it on chip damage. - Your ultimate: the win condition — spend it on kill windows, not on waves.
edits.after: - Lillia Blooming Blows (6s at rank 1, 4s at rank 5): her kite and move-speed engine, true damage on the edge. - Swirlseed (12s flat): a 700-range rolling slow that cuts your retreat, and you have no dash. - Lilting Lullaby (150s at rank 1): the dive window. - Your R: kill windows, never waves.

edits.before: From 6, Maximum Dosage turns extended fights unwinnable for Lillia. Cleaver-slow, walk him down with E, and only disengage if his Blooming Blows burst window is up and your R is down.
edits.after: From 6, Lilting Lullaby plus a jungler is the real threat — Maximum Dosage doesn't save you from a sleep dive. Cleaver-slow, walk her down with E, and disengage before Swirlseed cuts the path back.

edits.before: Track Lillia's Blooming Blows: Her kite + move speed stacks. When it is down — Cleaver-slow + run him down.
edits.after: Track Blooming Blows (4s at rank 5): her kite engine, true damage on the outer edge. When it's down, run her down.

notes: Level chart was self-contradicting (Level 6 and 2+ items were labelled Lillia while their own why-text said Mundo takes over); flipped to the packet chart and rewrote the why-text so no stage argues against its side. Killed the claim, in two places, that Blunt Force Trauma is a dash — Mundo has no mobility at all, which is why Swirlseed cutting the retreat matters and why Flash is the exit. Fixed 'Spirit Visor' to Spirit Visage. suspectNames hit on "Maximum Dosage's" is a false positive. UNVERIFIED and left alone: whether Dr. Mundo's passive consumes on Lilting Lullaby's drowsy or only on the sleep itself — Riot's text does not say and I would not guess.
